# CI dependency pins

External actions use full commit SHAs. The native-binding test containers in
`workflows/build-npm.yml` use explicit Node/distribution tags and image-index
digests. Renovate extracts these matrix values with a custom Docker manager;
updates stay on Node 22 and retain their distribution suffixes.

CodSpeed build jobs follow the [official example](https://github.com/CodSpeedHQ/action/blob/main/examples/rust-cargo-codspeed.yml),
installing `cargo-codspeed` through `moonrepo/setup-rust`. The run-only macro job
uses `taiki-e/install-action` so it does not reinstall the Rust toolchain.
All three jobs pin the same CLI version; Renovate updates them together under
the existing 14-day minimum release age. These version pins do not provide
repository-committed binary checksums: installation uses the actions' standard
cargo-binstall paths rather than a custom verified downloader.

`cargo-zigbuild` uses the version and checksums bundled with the pinned
`taiki-e/install-action` commit, with fallback installation disabled.

## Release bootstrap boundary

`workflows/release.yml` is generated by cargo-dist. Its versioned cargo-dist
installer is not independently checksum-pinned; its conditional container
bootstrap also downloads rustup. cargo-dist 0.31.0 has no supported hook that
replaces these installation steps (see its
[installation strategy](https://github.com/axodotdev/cargo-dist/blob/v0.31.0/cargo-dist/src/backend/ci/mod.rs#L88-L146)
and [workflow template](https://github.com/axodotdev/cargo-dist/blob/v0.31.0/cargo-dist/templates/ci/github/release.yml.j2)).
Keep changes in the generator configuration
rather than hand-editing the generated workflow. Replacing that bootstrap needs
an explicit decision to maintain the release workflow ourselves or generator
support for verified installation. These pins do not make the entire CI
execution environment immutable.
